description: Canonical AIPE Academy knowledge architecture: Domain -> Track -> Module. Lessons and labs attach to modules through curriculum/catalogue.json. Module ids are the knowledge-node identifiers shared by the website knowledge graph, the AI tutor integrations and the academic coverage map. Learning paths are a separate dimension: a recommended progression through modules and lessons, not a taxonomy.

summary.en: Shared knowledge layer for the three engineering domains: mathematics, physics, circuits, electronics, signals, computation and measurement, introduced progressively as engineering problems need them.
summary.zh: 三个专业领域共享的知识层：数学、物理、电路、电子学、信号、计算与测量，随着工程问题的需要逐步引入。

summary.en: Switching devices, converter topologies, losses, modelling, control, magnetics and the practical constraints of real converters.
summary.zh: 开关器件、变换器拓扑、损耗、建模、控制、磁性元件，以及真实变换器中的工程约束。

summary.en: Three-phase networks, transformers and machines, per-unit analysis, power flow, faults and protection, stability, and converter-dominated modern grids.
summary.zh: 三相网络、变压器与电机、标幺值分析、潮流、故障与保护、稳定性，以及由变换器主导的现代电网。

summary.en: Solar photovoltaics, wind, energy storage, energy conversion, and the grid integration of renewable generation through power electronics and power systems.
summary.zh: 光伏、风能、储能、能量转换，以及通过电力电子与电力系统实现可再生能源并网。

summary.en: How to learn engineering with an AI tutor: asking, predicting, verifying and recording evidence.
summary.zh: 如何与 AI 导师一起学习工程：提问、预测、验证并记录证据。

summary.en: Quantities and algebra, calculus and differential equations, linear algebra.
summary.zh: 数量与代数、微积分与微分方程、线性代数。

summary.en: Electricity and magnetism as physical phenomena before they become circuit models.
summary.zh: 在成为电路模型之前，作为物理现象的电与磁。

summary.en: DC circuit analysis, energy storage dynamics, periodic waveforms and AC analysis.
summary.zh: 直流电路分析、储能元件动态、周期波形与交流分析。

summary.en: Diodes, transistors as switches, operating points and simple electronic circuits.
summary.zh: 二极管、作为开关的晶体管、工作点与简单电子电路。

summary.en: Linear systems, frequency response, Laplace transforms and feedback fundamentals.
summary.zh: 线性系统、频率响应、拉普拉斯变换与反馈基础。

title.en: Programming, Scientific Computing and Numerical Methods
title.zh: 编程、科学计算与数值方法

summary.en: Python, plotting, simulation models, numerical error and step size.
summary.zh: Python、绘图、仿真模型、数值误差与步长。

summary.en: Magnetic circuits and saturation; measurement range, sampling, reference points and error.
summary.zh: 磁路与饱和；测量量程、采样、参考点与误差。

summary.en: Power semiconductors and the passive and magnetic components converters are built from.
summary.zh: 功率半导体，以及构成变换器的无源与磁性元件。

summary.en: Steady-state converter analysis: buck, boost and buck-boost families.
summary.zh: 稳态变换器分析：Buck、Boost 与 Buck-Boost 族。

title.zh: AC/DC 整流与 DC/AC 逆变

summary.en: Rectification, power factor correction, inverters and pulse-width modulation.
summary.zh: 整流、功率因数校正、逆变器与脉宽调制。

summary.en: Transformer-isolated topologies and resonant, soft-switched conversion.
summary.zh: 变压器隔离拓扑与谐振软开关变换。

summary.en: Conduction and switching losses, efficiency budgets and thermal design.
summary.zh: 导通与开关损耗、效率预算与热设计。

summary.en: Averaged and small-signal models, feedback and digital control, simulation practice.
summary.zh: 平均与小信号模型、反馈与数字控制、仿真实践。

summary.en: Inductor and transformer design for switching converters.
summary.zh: 面向开关变换器的电感与变压器设计。

title.en: Gate Driving, Protection, EMI and PCB Design
title.zh: 驱动、保护、EMI 与 PCB 设计

summary.en: The constraints of real hardware: driving, protection, layout and electromagnetic compatibility.
summary.zh: 真实硬件的约束：驱动、保护、布局与电磁兼容。

summary.en: How converters become products and infrastructure.
summary.zh: 变换器如何成为产品与基础设施。

summary.en: Three-phase systems, complex power, the per-unit system and network components.
summary.zh: 三相系统、复功率、标幺值系统与网络元件。

summary.en: Electromechanical energy conversion and transformer modelling.
summary.zh: 机电能量转换与变压器建模。

summary.en: Power-flow analysis, fault analysis with symmetrical components, protection and relaying.
summary.zh: 潮流分析、基于对称分量的故障分析、保护与继电。

title.zh: 稳定性、动态与电网控制

summary.en: Power system stability, dynamics, frequency and voltage control, grid operation.
summary.zh: 电力系统稳定性、动态、频率与电压控制、电网运行。

title.zh: 现代电网与变换器主导电网

summary.en: Grid-connected converters, grid-forming control, DC networks, microgrids and solid-state transformers.
summary.zh: 并网变换器、构网控制、直流网络、微电网与固态变压器。

summary.en: PV physics, I-V characteristics, maximum power point tracking and PV systems.
summary.zh: 光伏物理、I-V 特性、最大功率点跟踪与光伏系统。

summary.en: Wind resource, turbines, generators and their grid interfaces.
summary.zh: 风资源、风机、发电机及其并网接口。

summary.en: Storage technologies, batteries, management systems and bidirectional interfaces.
summary.zh: 储能技术、电池、管理系统与双向接口。

summary.en: Physical and thermodynamic foundations of renewable energy conversion.
summary.zh: 可再生能源转换的物理与热力学基础。

summary.en: Grid-connected renewable generation, microgrids and hybrid systems, energy management and system design.
summary.zh: 可再生能源并网、微电网与混合系统、能量管理与系统设计。

summary.en: Orientation to the field and the learning method: ask in ordinary language, predict, verify, record evidence of understanding.
summary.zh: 领域入门与学习方法：用普通语言提问、预测、验证，并记录理解的证据。

summary.en: Ratios, scientific notation, unit conversion and simple equations: the arithmetic every engineering estimate rests on.
summary.zh: 比例、科学计数法、单位换算与简单方程：一切工程估算所依赖的基本运算。

summary.en: Slopes, areas, exponentials and first-order differential equations, introduced through charging and discharging circuits.
summary.zh: 斜率、面积、指数函数与一阶微分方程，通过充放电电路引入。

summary.en: Systems of linear equations, matrices and state-space descriptions, introduced when node equations and dynamic models need them.
summary.zh: 线性方程组、矩阵与状态空间描述，在节点方程与动态模型需要时引入。

summary.en: Charge, electric field and potential, current, magnetic fields, Faraday's law and energy stored in fields.
summary.zh: 电荷、电场与电势、电流、磁场、法拉第定律以及场中储存的能量。

summary.en: Voltage, current, power and energy; Ohm's law, KCL, KVL, series and parallel networks and equivalent circuits.
summary.zh: 电压、电流、功率与能量；欧姆定律、KCL、KVL、串并联网络与等效电路。

summary.en: Capacitors and inductors, first-order differential equations, RC and RL responses and time constants.
summary.zh: 电容与电感、一阶微分方程、RC 与 RL 响应以及时间常数。

summary.en: Period, frequency, duty cycle, average and RMS values; complex numbers, phasors and impedance.
summary.zh: 周期、频率、占空比、平均值与有效值；复数、相量与阻抗。

summary.en: Simplified models of diodes and MOSFETs, operating points, losses and ratings.
summary.zh: 二极管与 MOSFET 的简化模型、工作点、损耗与额定值。

summary.en: Linear time-invariant systems, step and frequency response, Laplace transforms, poles, Bode plots and negative feedback.
summary.zh: 线性时不变系统、阶跃与频率响应、拉普拉斯变换、极点、Bode 图与负反馈。

summary.en: Scripts, plots and simulation models; numerical integration, step sizes and numerical error.
summary.zh: 脚本、绘图与仿真模型；数值积分、仿真步长与数值误差。

summary.en: Flux, induction, magnetic circuits and saturation; measurement range, sampling, reference points and error.
summary.zh: 磁通、感应、磁路与饱和；测量量程、采样、参考点与误差。

summary.en: Diodes, MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC and GaN as switches; datasheets, parasitics and conduction loss.
summary.zh: 作为开关的二极管、MOSFET、IGBT、SiC 与 GaN 器件；数据手册、寄生参数与导通损耗。

summary.en: Capacitors and inductors as real components: ESR, ESL, ripple-current ratings, saturation and tolerance.
summary.zh: 作为真实元件的电容与电感：ESR、ESL、纹波电流额定值、饱和与公差。

summary.en: Switching converters in steady state: volt-second and charge balance, conversion ratios, ripple, CCM and DCM.
summary.zh: 稳态下的开关变换器：伏秒平衡与电荷平衡、变比、纹波、CCM 与 DCM。

summary.en: The step-down converter worked from switch states to duty ratio, inductor ripple, conduction modes and component choice.
summary.zh: 从开关状态出发分析降压变换器，直至占空比、电感纹波、导通模式与元件选择。

title.zh: Boost 与 Buck-Boost 变换器

summary.en: Step-up and inverting converters, their conversion ratios, stresses and the right-half-plane zero.
summary.zh: 升压与反相变换器，它们的变比、应力以及右半平面零点。

summary.en: Diode and controlled rectifiers, harmonics, power factor and power factor correction.
summary.zh: 二极管整流与可控整流、谐波、功率因数与功率因数校正。

summary.en: Half- and full-bridge inverters, pulse-width modulation, harmonics and output filters.
summary.zh: 半桥与全桥逆变器、脉宽调制、谐波与输出滤波器。

summary.en: Transformer-based converters such as flyback, forward, bridge and dual-active-bridge stages.
summary.zh: 基于变压器的变换器，例如反激、正激、桥式与双有源桥。

summary.en: Resonant tanks, LLC stages, zero-voltage and zero-current switching.
summary.zh: 谐振腔、LLC 变换器、零电压与零电流开关。

summary.en: Conduction, switching, gate and magnetic losses; efficiency budgets and their measurement.
summary.zh: 导通、开关、驱动与磁性损耗；效率预算及其测量。

summary.en: Thermal resistance, junction temperature, heatsinks and cooling.
summary.zh: 热阻、结温、散热器与冷却。

summary.en: Averaged and small-signal models, linearisation around an operating point, and converter transfer functions.
summary.zh: 平均模型与小信号模型、围绕工作点的线性化，以及变换器传递函数。

summary.en: Loop design, compensation, phase and gain margins, voltage- and current-mode control, digital implementation.
summary.zh: 环路设计、补偿、相位与增益裕度、电压型与电流型控制、数字实现。

summary.en: Switching and averaged simulation with open tools, and checking a simulation result against hand analysis.
summary.zh: 使用开源工具进行开关模型与平均模型仿真，并用手算结果核对仿真。

summary.en: Inductor and transformer design: saturation, core loss, copper loss and leakage.
summary.zh: 电感与变压器设计：饱和、磁芯损耗、铜损与漏感。

summary.en: Gate driving, PCB layout, EMI, thermal design, protection and safety: the constraints of real hardware.
summary.zh: 栅极驱动、PCB 布局、EMI、热设计、保护与安全：真实硬件中的工程约束。

summary.en: Gate drivers, dead time, bootstrap supplies, isolation, overcurrent and overvoltage protection.
summary.zh: 栅极驱动器、死区、自举电源、隔离、过流与过压保护。

summary.en: Commutation loops, parasitic inductance, layout, filters and electromagnetic compatibility.
summary.zh: 换流回路、寄生电感、布局、滤波器与电磁兼容。

summary.en: How converters become products: chargers, server supplies, EV drives, solar inverters, requirements and trade-offs.
summary.zh: 变换器如何成为产品：充电器、服务器电源、电动汽车驱动、光伏逆变器，以及需求与权衡。

summary.en: Balanced three-phase circuits, phase and line quantities, real, reactive and apparent power, power factor.
summary.zh: 对称三相电路、相量与线量、有功、无功与视在功率、功率因数。

summary.en: Base quantities, per-unit impedances and how they simplify multi-voltage networks.
summary.zh: 基准值、标幺阻抗，以及它们如何简化多电压等级网络。

title.en: Power system components, transmission and distribution
title.zh: 电力系统元件、输电与配电

summary.en: Lines, cables, buses and loads; transmission and distribution structure and line models.
summary.zh: 线路、电缆、母线与负荷；输配电结构与线路模型。

summary.en: Ideal and real transformer models, equivalent circuits, three-phase connections.
summary.zh: 理想与实际变压器模型、等效电路、三相接法。

summary.en: Electromechanical energy conversion, synchronous and induction machines, machine models for system studies.
summary.zh: 机电能量转换、同步电机与感应电机、用于系统研究的电机模型。

summary.en: Network models and the power-flow problem: bus voltages, line flows and losses in a grid.
summary.zh: 电网模型与潮流问题：母线电压、线路潮流与网络损耗。

summary.en: Balanced and unbalanced faults, sequence networks and fault currents.
summary.zh: 对称与不对称故障、序网络与故障电流。

summary.en: Protection principles, relays, coordination and the challenges of converter-fed faults.
summary.zh: 保护原理、继电器、配合，以及变换器馈电故障带来的挑战。

title.zh: 电力系统稳定性与动态

summary.en: Rotor-angle, frequency and voltage stability; small-signal stability of grids with many converters.
summary.zh: 功角、频率与电压稳定性；含大量变换器的电网小信号稳定性。

summary.en: Frequency and voltage control, reserves, dispatch and the operation of interconnected systems.
summary.zh: 频率与电压控制、备用、调度以及互联系统的运行。

summary.en: Converters that exchange power with the grid: synchronisation, current control and grid-support functions.
summary.zh: 与电网交换功率的变换器：同步、电流控制与电网支撑功能。

title.zh: 变换器主导的电力系统

summary.en: Inverter-dominated grids, grid-forming converters, converter interaction and stability.
summary.zh: 逆变器主导电网、构网型变换器、变换器交互与稳定性。

summary.en: DC distribution, DC grids and the comparison of AC and DC networks.
summary.zh: 直流配电、直流电网，以及交直流网络的比较。

summary.en: DC, AC and hybrid microgrids: droop control, power sharing and energy management.
summary.zh: 直流、交流与交直流混合微电网：下垂控制、功率分配与能量管理。

summary.en: Multi-stage power-electronic transformers that interface medium-voltage grids, DC links and loads.
summary.zh: 连接中压电网、直流母线与负载的多级电力电子变压器。

summary.en: Photovoltaic energy conversion, the I-V characteristic, the maximum power point, and irradiance and temperature effects.
summary.zh: 光伏能量转换、I-V 特性、最大功率点，以及辐照度与温度的影响。

summary.en: Why PV needs a converter, perturb-and-observe and other MPPT algorithms, and their limits.
summary.zh: 光伏为何需要变换器、扰动观察法及其他 MPPT 算法，以及它们的局限。

title.en: PV systems, inverters and grid interfaces
title.zh: 光伏系统、逆变器与并网接口

summary.en: Arrays, string and central inverters, grid-connected and off-grid PV systems.
summary.zh: 阵列、组串式与集中式逆变器、并网与离网光伏系统。

summary.en: Wind resource and power in the wind, turbine aerodynamics, generators and the back-to-back converters that connect them to the grid.
summary.zh: 风资源与风能、风机空气动力学、发电机及其连接电网的背靠背变换器。

summary.en: Storage technologies and their roles, energy and power ratings, round-trip efficiency, and bidirectional converter interfaces.
summary.zh: 储能技术及其作用、能量与功率额定值、循环效率，以及双向变换器接口。

summary.en: Electrochemical cells, battery chemistries, state of charge, ageing and battery management systems.
summary.zh: 电化学电池、电池体系、荷电状态、老化与电池管理系统。

summary.en: Energy, power and efficiency across physical conversion processes; the resources and limits of renewable energy.
summary.zh: 各类物理转换过程中的能量、功率与效率；可再生能源的资源与极限。

summary.en: Connecting variable renewable generation and storage to the grid: grid codes, hosting capacity and stability.
summary.zh: 把波动性可再生能源与储能接入电网：并网规范、承载能力与稳定性。

title.zh: 微电网与混合能源系统

summary.en: Combining solar, wind, storage and conventional sources in microgrids and hybrid systems.
summary.zh: 在微电网与混合系统中组合光伏、风电、储能与常规电源。

summary.en: Forecasting, scheduling and control of energy flows in renewable and storage systems.
summary.zh: 可再生能源与储能系统中能量流的预测、调度与控制。

summary.en: Sizing, component selection, economics and verification of a renewable energy system.
summary.zh: 可再生能源系统的容量配置、元件选型、经济性与验证。

summary.en: The original AIPE Academy progression from orientation to systems, with the G1/G2/G3 readiness checks. Stages are a recommended order through the taxonomy, not additional domains.
summary.zh: AIPE Academy 最初的学习递进，从领域入门到系统应用，含 G1/G2/G3 准备度检查。阶段是穿越知识体系的推荐顺序，不是额外的领域。

title.zh: 阶段 00 · 领域入门与学习方法
G1 · 可以开始基础变换器

en: Label voltages and currents in a simple circuit and write KCL/KVL
Compute power and energy and distinguish W from Wh
Explain inductor current and capacitor voltage continuity and the ideal-model conditions
Distinguish period, duty cycle, average and RMS
Distinguish an ideal switch from a real device and judge whether a simulation result is plausible
zh: 能为简单电路标出电压、电流方向并写出 KCL/KVL
能计算功率与能量，分清 W 与 Wh
能解释电感电流和电容电压的连续性及相应理想模型条件
能解释周期、占空比、平均值与 RMS 的区别
能区分理想开关与实际器件，并检查一个仿真结果是否合理

title.en: G2 · Ready for dynamics and control
title.zh: G2 · 可以开始变换器动态与控制

en: Explain step response, poles and frequency response
State where a small-signal model applies and verify with a changed parameter
Solve a small linear system and explain numerical error at an introductory level
zh: 能解释阶跃响应、极点和频率响应
理解小信号模型适用范围，并用改变参数的例子验证
能求解小型线性方程组并说明数值误差入门概念

title.en: G3 · Ready for engineering design and research preparation
title.zh: G3 · 可以开始工程设计与研究准备

en: Produce a design with specification, device constraints and a verification record
Reproduce one documented result with assumptions, errors, failures and applicability recorded
zh: 完成一项有规格、器件约束和验证记录的设计
复现一项明确结果，记录假设、误差、失败与适用范围

summary.en: A beginner's entry path through the shared Foundations layer. Steps whose module has no lesson yet are taught by the AI tutor from the module outline.
summary.zh: 面向初学者的基础层入门路线。尚无课程的模块由 AI 导师根据模块大纲讲授。

title.en: Power systems: from AC circuits to the grid
title.zh: 电力系统：从交流电路到电网

summary.en: Electrical circuits → AC and three-phase systems → transformers → per-unit → power flow → machines → faults and protection → stability and grid control.
summary.zh: 电路 → 交流与三相系统 → 变压器 → 标幺值 → 潮流 → 电机 → 故障与保护 → 稳定性与电网控制。

title.en: Renewable energy: from the solar cell to the grid
title.zh: 可再生能源：从太阳能电池到电网

summary.en: Energy conversion → solar PV fundamentals → MPPT → storage → wind → grid integration and system design.
summary.zh: 能量转换 → 光伏基础 → MPPT → 储能 → 风能 → 并网与系统设计。
